newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA OFFERS 3-, 12-MTH DISCOUNT T-BILLS MONDAY.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA OFFERS 3-, 12-MTH DISCOUNT T-BILLS MONDAY.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry said on Wednesday it will offer two discount T-bill issues with a total par of 12 billion levs ($6.5 million) and maturities of three and 12 months at auctions on Monday.
The government securities will be offered with no minimum acceptable prices set in advance.

The maximum amount of paper a single bank can buy at the auctions through competitive bids is set at 15 percent of the par value earmarked for such bids for the three-month maturity and 35 percent for the one-year T-bills.
Of the total par on offer, 95 percent is earmarked for competitive bids and the remaining five percent for non-competitive bids.
Par value 4.0 bln levs 8.0 bln levs
